name: Miniature carousel

source_gallery.name: Miniature carousel
source_gallery.description: The refined canopy, horses and platform turn together above the fixed base.
source_gallery.note: Assisted refinement of an existing generated carousel. The cracked canopy was repaired with a continuous red-and-ivory shell, brass trim and revised surface finishes. Native decorative detail and the recorded MuJoCo turn-and-return animation are retained; the horses do not move independently. This qualitative showcase does not add to the benchmark scores.

scope: Existing asset packaging and presentation rerender only; source physical evaluation status is retained in the original delivery records.
